description: The duplicate scan exists only in the module.is_global() branch (world.rs). The non-global branch (world.rs:2343-2346) just waits on ModuleDefined with no duplicate check; nothing in source_publish.rs/world.rs diagnoses two fns of the same name+arity inside the same (or two) defmodule Foo do...end blocks. Consistent with fz-zbp title scoping to global name+arity, but a real un-diagnosed gap. Mirror the duplicate-struct/duplicate-function shape for module-scoped defs.
title: fz-zbp: no duplicate-definition diagnostic for MODULE-scoped functions (two def foo inside defmodule) -- only global-module top-level is covered
